concept: MLX Metal queue contention between two processes on one GPU
summary: MLX calls `newCommandQueue()` once per stream encoder and attaches the residency sets to that queue, so processes never share a queue

facts.text: MLX calls `newCommandQueue()` once per stream encoder and attaches the residency sets to that queue, so processes never share a queue
MLX command buffers use unretained references; buffers are kept alive by MLX through completion handlers
Default per-command-buffer limits are 20 ops/40 MB (phone), 40/40 (base and Pro), 50/50 (Max and Ultra), overridable by environment variables
